UpdateStageName: Initialize PostgreSQL and enforce TLS-only remote HBA
UpdateSourceArgs: -c "set -euo pipefail; Settings=postgresql/settings; Base=$(<\"$Settings/base-dir\"); AllowedDatabase=$(<\"$Settings/allowed-database\"); AllowedRole=$(<\"$Settings/allowed-role\"); AllowedIPv4CIDR=$(<\"$Settings/allowed-ipv4-cidr\"); AllowedIPv6CIDR=$(<\"$Settings/allowed-ipv6-cidr\"); [[ \"$Base\" == /*/ && \"$Base\" != *$'\n'* && \"$Base\" != *$'\r'* ]] || { echo 'Invalid AMP PostgreSQL base directory'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedDatabase\" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid allowed database identifier'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedRole\" =~ ^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid allowed role identifier'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedIPv4CIDR\" =~ ^[0-9./]+$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid IPv4 CIDR characters'; exit 1; }; [[ \"$AllowedIPv6CIDR\" =~ ^[0-9a-fA-F:./]+$ ]] || { echo 'Invalid IPv6 CIDR characters'; exit 1; }; cd \"$Base\"; if [[ ! -f \"${Base}data/PG_VERSION\" ]]; then pgsql/bin/initdb --pgdata=\"${Base}data\" --auth-local=peer --auth-host=reject --username=amp; echo 'Initialized PostgreSQL with local peer authentication and remote reject defaults'; fi; Hba=\"${Base}data/pg_hba.conf\"; umask 077; printf '%s\n' 'local all amp peer' 'local all all scram-sha-256' 'hostnossl all all 0.0.0.0/0 reject' 'hostnossl all all ::0/0 reject' \"hostssl $AllowedDatabase $AllowedRole $AllowedIPv4CIDR scram-sha-256\" \"hostssl $AllowedDatabase $AllowedRole $AllowedIPv6CIDR scram-sha-256\" > \"$Hba\"; echo 'Installed deterministic TLS-only remote HBA rules'"
